GraphRAG Builder Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release: build a full MCP knowledge server from any website or documentation URL in five local pipeline steps.
- Includes scripts for crawling sites, extracting concepts with LLM (Opus, Sonnet, etc), constructing a knowledge graph, generating vector embeddings, and outputting a ready-to-run MCP server.
- Supports semantic search and eight graph-based retrieval tools out of the box.
- Guides users step-by-step, including setup, requirements, error handling, and sample command sequences.
- Designed for easy integration with agent harnesses via generated config snippets.
